# [TASK] Terraform: Azure AKS free-tier infrastructure

## Task
Provision the primary Azure demo environment with Terraform (ARCHITECTURE.md §11.2): an AKS cluster (Free control-plane tier) with one small node, a network module, and a budget-guard module (a zero-spend Azure Cost Management budget + alert, replacing a paid container registry — images pull from ghcr.io instead). CI authenticates to Azure without a stored long-lived secret.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `terraform apply` -> `kubectl apply -k overlays/azure` -> `terraform destroy` round-trip completed against a real Azure subscription, zero manual console steps (`terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform/azure validate`)
- [x] All taggable Terraform resources carry `project=lmdb`, `managed-by=terraform` via `var.tags` (`grep -c 'tags = var.tags' infrastructure/terraform/azure/main.tf infrastructure/terraform/modules/network/main.tf infrastructure/terraform/modules/cluster-aks/main.tf` — 1 each; Azure Consumption Budgets don't support tags at all, the one exception)
- [x] CI authenticates via GitHub OIDC federated credentials — no stored `ARM_CLIENT_SECRET` (`grep -c ARM_USE_OIDC .github/workflows/terraform-plan.yml .github/workflows/deploy.yml .github/workflows/destroy.yml .github/workflows/cluster-stop.yml .github/workflows/cluster-idle-stop.yml`; `grep -c ARM_CLIENT_SECRET` across the same files returns 0)
- [x] Gateway reachable end-to-end on the deployed cluster — real TMDB data flowing gateway -> movie-service -> MongoDB -> Redis -> gateway (`terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform/azure validate`)
- [x] Cluster runs within Azure free credits, budget-guard tripwire live — `Standard_D4ls_v7` (the B-series family is blocked as anti-abuse on this subscription; bumped from `Standard_D2ls_v7` in #151 for the full local-parity service set) is a small real hourly cost, covered by free credits — same "free" definition as #27 (`infrastructure/terraform/azure/variables.tf`'s `vm_size` default)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 15

## Notes
Second live-apply pass (2026-08-01) found and fixed 4 more bugs: missing `movie-service` `startupProbe`, AKS's auto-created per-node NSG blocking the gateway, an `upgrade_settings` drift bug forcing a spurious NSG replace on every plan, and IPv6-only DNS resolution hanging outbound JVM calls (fixed via `-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true`). `terraform destroy` reconfirmed clean afterward. ARCHITECTURE.md corrected to match (v1.6.1).

The second and fifth criteria above reflect `variables.tf`'s current defaults, not the ones this Task closed with: the repo's rebrand to `lmdb.dev` changed the tag from `project=filmpire` to `project=lmdb`, and #151's full local-parity service set (actor/user/ai-service, Postgres, Ollama) bumped the node size from `Standard_D2ls_v7` to `Standard_D4ls_v7`.

Reference: ARCHITECTURE.md §11.1-11.2
